name: QuickNode
description: Multi-chain RPC and infrastructure provider. Competes with Alchemy across EVM chains and Solana. Known for Yellowstone gRPC streaming on Solana for ultra-low-latency data access, and broad chain coverage beyond Base and Ethereum.

ecosystem_fit.notes: Yellowstone gRPC streaming is a differentiated capability for Solana — provides real-time transaction streaming at much lower latency than HTTP polling. Preferred over Alchemy for latency-sensitive Solana workloads.
Viable Alchemy alternative for Base RPC. Use when already on QuickNode stack for multi-chain coverage.
Production-grade Ethereum RPC with MEV-boost endpoint access.
Used as the Base/Ethereum RPC layer under Farcaster miniapps when QuickNode is the existing infrastructure provider.

common_pairings.context: Helius is Solana-native with richer indexed data APIs; QuickNode offers Yellowstone gRPC streaming and broader chain coverage. Both are viable Solana RPC providers — choose based on whether you need rich indexed APIs (Helius) or streaming + multi-chain (QuickNode).
QuickNode RPC with Jito MEV bundles for Solana trading bots requiring MEV protection.
Alchemy and QuickNode are the two dominant EVM RPC providers. Alchemy is the default for Base; QuickNode preferred when multi-chain coverage or Solana Yellowstone streaming is required.

trust_evidence.description: QuickNode is a major infrastructure provider used in production across EVM and Solana. Yellowstone gRPC is cited in Solana trading agent patterns as the canonical low-latency streaming approach.
Comprehensive documentation for Yellowstone gRPC, multi-chain RPC, and SDK integrations.

scale_guidance.hackathon: Use Alchemy free tier instead — simpler setup for EVM. QuickNode for Solana if Yellowstone streaming is needed for the demo.
scale_guidance.mvp: Viable RPC provider for both EVM and Solana. Main decision factor: existing team familiarity vs. Alchemy.
scale_guidance.production: Yellowstone gRPC is the production choice for latency-sensitive Solana workloads. For EVM, choose between Alchemy and QuickNode based on existing stack and pricing.

alternatives.when_to_prefer: Default choice for Base and Ethereum. Better webhook integration and stronger Base-native tooling.
Solana-only deployments needing rich indexed APIs, NFT metadata, and webhook notifications. Helius is more Solana-native than QuickNode.

anti_patterns: Using public RPCs in production instead of QuickNode or Alchemy — rate limits and reliability make public RPCs unacceptable for production.
Using QuickNode HTTP polling for Solana MEV-sensitive workloads when Yellowstone gRPC streaming is available — gRPC delivers significantly lower latency.
